messages.subject: r-nimble.org is back online
parts:
Thanks to those of you who alerted us to problems with our site, r-nimble.org

The site should be back online. Please let me know if you have any further problems.

The outage happened from a glitch in a migration to new hardware that was conducted over the weekend. That  said, we owe a huge thanks to the IT staff of the Rausser College of Natural Resources here at UC Berkeley for maintaining the site over the years.

Perry
